name: harness-forge-workspace
description: Harness Forge: run Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode plugins in DeepSeek Harness

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @kirkchinese/harness-forge-core build && pnpm --filter @kirkchinese/harness-forge build && pnpm --filter @kirkchinese/harness-forge build:client
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @kirkchinese/harness-forge-core typecheck && pnpm --filter @kirkchinese/harness-forge typecheck && pnpm --filter @kirkchinese/harness-forge typecheck:client && pnpm --filter @kirkchinese/harness-forge-testkit typecheck
